description.value: Taishoken is a Japanese ramen restaurant in Vancouver's downtown core, specializing in tonkotsu, miso, and tsukemen-style noodle bowls. The menu spans a range of broth styles alongside gyoza, rice dishes, and several vegetarian options. Online ordering with pickup is available directly through the restaurant's website.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 32m; stands (4 spaces) at 48m; stands (3 spaces) at 51m; rack at 67m; rack at 72m; rack (12 spaces) at 80m; stands (2 spaces) at 85m. Total: 24 spaces.
